Keeping peptides cool in La Quinta

La Quinta has no NOAA normals station of its own. The nearest two both sit below sea level: Indio Fire Station, about 6 miles north-northeast, and Desert Resorts Regional Airport near Thermal, about 6 miles east.12138 Their July average highs are 105.8 °F and 106.9 °F, and July nights average 82.5 °F at Indio and 75.6 °F at the airport.1213 The airport's daily record, kept since 1950 with some gaps, peaks at 126 °F on July 28, 1995.14 In July 2024 it reached 110 °F or more on 23 of 31 days.14

Winter flips the picture. December nights average 45.3 °F at Indio but 37.7 °F at the airport, which averages about 19 freezing nights a year, against 1 at Indio.123134 For sealed freeze-dried powder, cold is the recommended condition: GenScript, a peptide maker, advises storing it at -20 °C.15 The rules change once a vial is mixed. GenScript says peptides that go through freeze-thaw cycles are prone to degrade, and that splitting a stock into single-use aliquots cuts both the number of cycles and air exposure.15 Labels for approved freeze-dried products, such as EGRIFTA WR (tesamorelin) and ZOMACTON (somatropin), say not to freeze the solution after mixing.1617 The storage guide and the reconstitution guide cover both stages.

About La Quinta

La Quinta incorporated on May 1, 1982, and took its name from the La Quinta Resort, established in 1926.2 Today the La Quinta Resort & Club is the largest resort in the Coachella Valley.11 The city is home to PGA West and hosts the PGA Tour's American Express tournament, formerly the Bob Hope Classic.11 It counts 25 golf courses and 16 parks.2

The Santa Rosa Mountains nearly surround the city, and the water line of ancient freshwater Lake Cahuilla still shows along their base.2 Lake Cahuilla Veterans Regional Park, a 710-acre county park with a 135-acre fishing lake and 96 individual and group campsites, lies at the foot of the mountains about 6 miles southeast of Old Town La Quinta.18 Old Town's village area has boutique shops and restaurants, Highway 111 carries the main commercial corridor, and the Bear Creek Trail is a local biking route.211

The city had an estimated 39,440 residents on July 1, 2025, about 4.5% more than its 2020 base of 37,743 but 195 fewer than in 2024.1 That ranks it 19th among the county's 28 incorporated cities.1 It covers 35.294 square miles of land and 0.425 square miles of water.8 The median age is 53.3, with 31.6% of residents 65 or older and 16.5% under 18.19 Educational services, health care and social assistance employ the largest share of working residents (21.9%), and 17.7% of workers work from home.20 Owners occupy 75.7% of occupied homes, and mobile homes make up only 2.3% of housing units.9

Two university campuses are in Palm Desert, whose center is about 9 miles from La Quinta's.8 CSUSB's Palm Desert Campus is the Coachella Valley's only four-year public university, and its health sciences building holds biology, chemistry and nursing labs.21 UC Riverside's Palm Desert Center has been a base for several UCR research programs since 2005.22 La Quinta joined the Desert Healthcare District after valley voters approved extending its boundary east of Cook Street on November 6, 2018.23 The district provides nearly 4 million dollars a year for local health projects.23

Nearby

In a straight line from La Quinta's center, Indian Wells is about 5.5 miles away, Indio about 7 and Coachella about 8.8 Palm Desert is about 9 miles northwest, Palm Springs about 19 and Desert Hot Springs about 27.8 Riverside, the county seat, is about 68 miles west-northwest.8 Peptides in Riverside is the hub for the county's pages, and the locations page lists every place we cover.

Frequently asked questions

How is semaglutide different from the body's own GLP-1?

The 2015 Journal of Medicinal Chemistry paper that described its discovery reports two amino acid substitutions compared with human GLP-1, Aib at position 8 and Arg at position 34, plus a chemical modification (derivatization) at lysine 26.5 In mini-pigs, its plasma half-life was 46.1 hours after intravenous dosing, and its mean residence time was 63.6 hours after dosing under the skin.5 Those are animal figures. What is Semaglutide? covers the human research.

Does all of La Quinta share one ZIP code?

Almost. In the Census Bureau's 2020 ZIP Code Tabulation Areas, 92253 covers about 96.3% of La Quinta's land, and the small remainder falls in other ZIP areas.6 Orders to any La Quinta address ship from the USA and Canada, the same as orders across the United States, under the policy on the shipping page. If a parcel arrives damaged, the returns page explains what to do.

Where is the nearest trauma center to La Quinta?

Of the Coachella Valley trauma centers named in a March 2023 news report, the closest are Level 4 centers: JFK Memorial Hospital in neighboring Indio, whose center is about 7 miles from La Quinta's, and Eisenhower Health in Rancho Mirage, about 13 miles away center to center.78 The same report says the Riverside County Emergency Medical Services Agency had made Desert Regional Medical Center in Palm Springs the valley's first Level 1 trauma center. Palm Springs' center is about 19 miles from La Quinta's.78
